note.zh: 同一阶段按权重抽取：375 权重1，仅对方为“狂热净化者”；376 权重3，对方须为好战且非净化者；377 权重1，仅对方不是净化者。
note.en: One stage draws among them by weight: 375 (weight 1) only if they are fanatic purifiers; 376 (weight 3) only if they are militarist non-purifiers; 377 (weight 1) only if they are not purifiers.

label.en: Two endings if we stayed silent

note.zh: 378 权重3（对方是净化者或好战才可能）；379 权重1（对方是净化者时为0）。
note.en: 378 (weight 3) needs a purifier or militarist contact; 379 (weight 1) is zero when the contact is a purifier.

note.zh: 得知对方是狂热净化者；无额外加成，仅结束首次接触。
note.en: Learns they are fanatic purifiers; no extra reward, first contact ends.

label.zh: 结局：配得上他们的挑战

note.zh: 获得10年的“战士得到承认/被默认”修正，对方给予“赢得尊重”好感。
note.en: 10-year warrior-recognised (or presumed) modifier; the other side gains a respect-earned opinion.

note.zh: 对方好感大降；选择“非亲异族”仍可获得少量团结度。
note.en: Their opinion of you drops sharply; choosing the non-xenophile answer still earns a little unity.

label.en: Ending: failed to answer the challenge

note.zh: 对方认为我方懦弱（cowardly 好感修正）。
note.en: They think us cowardly (cowardly opinion modifier).

note.zh: 对方开火，唯一的选项是“拿起武器！”
note.en: They open fire; the only option is “To arms!”.

notes.zh: 审阅注：选项B“回敬威胁噪音”在隐藏效果中 90% 进入“回应通知”阶段（→370），10% 直接打响（500，并转入谨慎收尾阶段）；若对方是和平主义者则 10% 档权重为0。选项C“备战”获得5400天的备战修正并转入通用收尾阶段。
notes.en: Review note: option B (return threatening noises) rolls 9:1 in a hidden random_list — the 9 enters the “their reaction” stage (370), the 1 starts a fight (500) and the cautious end stage; the 1 is removed if the contact is pacifist. Option C (prepare for war) grants a 5400-day war-preparations modifier and uses the generic end stage.

notes.zh: 审阅注：370 的两个选项（有趣/令人担忧）效果相同，都转入“回应收尾阶段”（难度3）。
notes.en: Review note: both options of 370 (intriguing / worrying) are identical and enter the end stage (difficulty 3).
